svg.title: Recentered reapernoid profiles have dimension-dependent forward limits
svg.desc: Numerical profiles u(x,t)-u(0,t), with no spatial rescaling. In R3 the limiting profile is a line. In R4 the limiting profile is a grim reaper. Gold dashed curves show the proved limits, not finite-time slices.

g.text: After recentering at the neck · different forward limits
Height = u(x, t) − u(0, t). Translation only; no spatial rescaling.
Gold dashed: the forward pointed limit proved in Theorem 1.3.
ℝ³: curvature tends to zero. Higher dimensions: a grim reaper of the catenoid’s strip width.
Finite-time numerical profiles need not equal their limits. Each neck continues moving outward.
Only n = 2 and n = 3 are computed here; the theorem covers every n ≥ 2.
Mramor–Payne, §4, especially (4.5) and p. 20. Numerical sensitivity checks accompany the data.
